question: The book 'Coaching Beyond: My Days with the Indian Cricket Team' is authored by R Sridhar and the foreword is by _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**VVS Laxman**__.

__
 
• A book titled ‘COACHING BEYOND: My Days with the Indian Cricket Team’, authored by R. Kaushik & R. Sridhar, was released in January 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The book reflects on R. Sridhar’s seven-year coaching tenure with the Indian cricket team as its fielding coach.
